pending: The harness's own checks: fixtures that prove what the runner does, so there is no screenshot to compare them with.

comparisons.name: pointer-parked
comparisons.description: Nothing is hovered unless an action hovers it. The block sits at the page origin, where a pointer that never moved rests; the runner takes the pointer out of the window before the capture.

pixels.note: the fixture's colour at rest, beside the origin
the fixture's colour at rest, in the middle

comparisons.name: pointer-parked-oversized
comparisons.description: A capture larger than the window, with no declared size: every point of the window is inside it, so the pointer is parked outside the window and the block is drawn at rest.

pixels.note: the fixture's colour at rest, beside the origin
the fixture's colour at rest, in the middle of the smallest window
the fixture's colour at rest, at the bottom right corner of the smallest window, where the pointer used to be parked
the fixture's colour at rest, beyond the edge of the smallest window: the capture is larger than the window

comparisons.name: lazy-image-loaded
comparisons.description: An image marked loading="lazy" far below the window is loaded before the capture, which reaches it: the page asks for it instead of waiting for a scroll that never comes.

pixels.note: the fixture's background, above the image
the image's colour; the fixture's background shows instead while the image is not loaded

comparisons.name: chained-image-loaded
comparisons.description: Three lazy images, each put on the page by the load handler of the one before: the page looks for images again until none is loading, so all of them are loaded before the capture.

pixels.note: the third image's colour; the fixture's background shows instead when the page looked for images only once per wait

comparisons.name: pointer-hover-action
comparisons.description: The same block hovered with an action: the fixture can tell a hovered block from one at rest, and an action after the parking still moves the pointer.

comparisons.name: forced-colors-off
comparisons.description: Without forcedColors the browser is not in a forced-colours mode, whatever the machine's setting.

pixels.note: the fixture's colour outside forced colours
the fixture's colour inside its forced-colors media query
